verdict.rationale: GlitchTip documents per-project alert rules triggered by error frequency. Those alerts go by email to the project's team members or to an added webhook URL, and teams exist to route notifications to the right people. This covers project-level routing and frequency thresholds. missing for 10: routing by environment or severity, native Slack and PagerDuty destinations (only a generic webhook is documented), an explicit new-issue trigger, affected-user-count thresholds, and independent or hands-on corroboration of alert configuration.
